title: 36 Hours in Midcoast Maine
abstract: Working harbors and painterly landscapes meet storied restaurants, a rich literary tradition and a thriving arts scene on this low-key stretch of Maine’s coastline.

title: 36 Hours in Stockholm
abstract: The breezy Swedish capital beckons in late summer, with new swimming piers, forest art installations, rooftop bars and budget-friendly boat rides.

title: 36 Hours on Lake Como, Italy
abstract: One of Italy’s most poetic destinations now shares the stage with a new generation of hotels, restaurants and an increasingly high-profile crowd.

title: 36 Hours in New Orleans
abstract: The Big Easy has never been more appealing, thanks to an increasingly global food scene, a sparkling new riverfront park and plenty of that good time spirit.

title: 36 Hours in Vancouver, British Columbia
abstract: It’s never been easier to explore this Pacific Northwest city, where once-quiet neighborhoods now buzz with new global restaurants and community art spaces.
